question: Choose the word that is the antonym of **Get back**.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Lose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks for the antonym of the phrase **"Get back"**, which means to regain or recover something.
 
• Out of the options given:
 
 
• **Regain:** Synonym of "Get back," meaning to recover something.
 
• **Retrieve:** Synonym of "Get back," referring to bringing something back.
 
• **Recover:** Synonym of "Get back," indicating restoration or reclamation.
 
• **Lose:** Antonym of "Get back," as it means to be deprived of or unable to retain something.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The antonym of "Get back" is **Lose**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms:** Words with similar meanings that can be used interchangeably (e.g., regain, retrieve, recover).
 
• **Antonyms:** Words with opposite meanings (e.g., lose).
